LanguageData.MSSFP_IS_BiocodedDesc: The previous owner's biocoding is fused into this part and cannot be stripped. It will not accept a new host, so no surgeon can install it. It is worth something to a trader who only wants the materials.
LanguageData.MSSFP_IS_BiocodedMessage: {0} came out biocoded to its dead owner. It cannot be installed, only sold.
LanguageData.MSSFP_IS_Settings_Blurb: Implants cut from a corpse may still carry the dead owner's biocoding. A biocoded part can never be installed, and sells for a quarter of the normal price. This is on top of Implant Salvage's own chance to destroy the implant outright.
LanguageData.MSSFP_IS_Settings_BiocodeChance: Chance a surviving implant is biocoded: {0}
